# McStas instrument file for the specified TAS setup

# Define the instrument
instrument my_tas_instrument

# Set global parameters
set KF = 5
set KI = 0
set QM = 1
set EN = 0
set verbose = 1
set WM = 0.233
set HM = 0.197
set RMH = -1
set RMV = -1
set DM = 1.807
set NHM = 15
set NVM = 15
set WA = 0.16
set HA = 0.08
set RAH = -1
set RAV = -1
set DA = 2.087
set NHA = 15
set NVA = 15
set L1 = 2.3
set ALF1 = 60
set ALF2 = 60
set ALF3 = 60
set ALF4 = 60
set BET1 = 120
set BET2 = 120
set BET3 = 120
set BET4 = 120
set Sqw_coh = V.lau

# Define components
component Progress_bar
    type = monitor
    xwidth = 0.5
    yheight = 0.5
    zwidth = 0.5
    position = [0, 0, 0]
    restore_neutron = 1
    verbose = 1
end

component Source_gen
    type = source
    radius = 0.10
    dist = machine_hkl.l1
    focus_xw = fabs(WM*sin(machine_real.a1*DEG2RAD))
    focus_yh = HM
    E0 = machine_hkl.ei
    dE = machine_hkl.ei*0.03
    I1 = 0.5874e+13
    T1 = 683.7
    T2 = 257.7
    I2 = 2.5099e+13
    T3 = 16.7
    I3 = 1.0343e+12
end

component Collimator_linear
    type = collimator
    xmin = -WM/2
    xmax = WM/2
    ymin = -HM/2
    ymax = HM/2
    length = machine_hkl.l1/2
    divergence = ALF1
    divergenceV = BET1
    when = (ALF1 && BET1)
end

component Arm
    type = guide
    position = [0, 0, machine_hkl.l1-0.2]
    rotation = [0, 0, 0]
    length = 0.2
    radius = 0.1
    divergence = ALF1
    divergenceV = BET1
end

component Wavelength_monitor
    type = monitor
    xwidth = 0.5
    yheight = 0.5
    zwidth = 0.5
    position = [0, 0, machine_hkl.l1]
    restore_neutron = 1
    verbose = 1
end

component Position_sensitive_monitor
    type = monitor
    xwidth = 0.5
    yheight = 0.5
    zwidth = 0.5
    position = [0, 0, machine_hkl.l1 + 0.2]
    restore_neutron = 1
    verbose = 1
end

# Define the beamline
source Source_gen
    position = [0, 0, 0]
    rotation = [0, 0, 0]
    output = [Progress_bar]

collimator Collimator_linear
    position = [0, 0, machine_hkl.l1/4]
    rotation = [0, 0, 0]
    input = Source_gen
    output = [Progress_bar]

guide Arm
    position = [0, 0, machine_hkl.l1-0.2]
    rotation = [0, 0, 0]
    input = Collimator_linear
    output = [Progress_bar]

monitor Wavelength_monitor
    position = [0, 0, machine_hkl.l1]
    rotation = [0, 0, 0]
    input = Arm
    output = [Progress_bar]

monitor Position_sensitive_monitor
    position = [0, 0, machine_hkl.l1 + 0.2]
    rotation = [0, 0, 0]
    input = Arm
    output = [Progress_bar]

# End of instrument
end

# Run the instrument
run
    ncount = 1e6
    seed = 123456789
    verbose = 1
end

# Output the results
print
    monitor = Wavelength_monitor
    format = "Integrated intensity on Wavelength monitor: I = %f ± %f (events = %d, ncount = %d, seed = %d)"
end

print
    monitor = Position_sensitive_monitor
    format = "Integrated intensity on Position-sensitive monitor: I = %f ± %f (events = %d, ncount = %d, seed = %d)"
end
